author: oglez
body:
Changing the NanoAOD variable Muon_tuneP_charge to int instead of a float.

This is a cherry-pick from a similar commit that was already accepted in master

We have changed the type of variable produced in the NanoAOD for the variable Muon_tuneP_charge defined in the file PhysicsTools/NanoAOD/python/muons_cff.py (just a one-line change to have an int instead of a float with precision 6 (that was used for unknown motivations).
Impact should be negligible both in usage and in performance. Perhaps a tiny reduction of the size if the int is easily packed than the float. The amount of information is the same.
title: Changing the NanoAOD Muon_tuneP_charge to int instead of a float
